payload.interpretation: Retrospective development comparison designed after E022 aggregate and subgroup scores were known. Acquisition has begun but no NBH errors have been computed. Actual September receipts are retained; original object storage time is only a conditional availability gate. Station forecasts are not exchange settlement forecasts. No financial promotion or untouched-test claim.

evaluation.metric_weighting: Equal UTC target-day weight, equal case weight within each day; RMSE is the square root of day-weighted squared error.
evaluation.point_metric_basis: Raw baseline point forecasts or pretrained/fitted neural medians before quantile calibration.
